hero.subtitle: World-class physical therapy combining advanced medicine, cutting-edge technology and deeply human care.

about.title: Where Science Meets
about.description: For 15 years we have helped people reclaim their mobility, strength and confidence through evidence-based rehabilitation in a space designed for wellness.
about.missionText: To make world-class rehabilitation accessible, personal and human — helping every patient move better and live stronger.
about.visionText: A future where recovery is seamless, technology-driven and available to everyone.

treatments.description: A structured, science-backed timeline from assessment to full recovery.
treatments.stage1Text: Comprehensive evaluation of your condition, history and goals.
treatments.stage2Text: A tailored treatment roadmap built around your body and lifestyle.
treatments.stage3Text: Hands-on therapy, guided exercise and technology-assisted modalities.
treatments.stage4Text: Objective measurements, milestones and continuous plan refinement.
treatments.stage5Text: Graduation to full function with a long-term wellness strategy.

anatomy.title: Explore the
anatomy.description: An interactive 3D journey through the structures we treat every day. Rotate, zoom and switch between views to understand how your body works.

controls.drag: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom

spine.name: Spine
spine.description: The vertebral column supports your entire body while protecting the spinal cord. Its natural S-curve distributes weight and enables fluid, balanced movement.

knee.name: Knee
knee.description: One of the largest and most stressed joints in the body, the knee relies on cartilage, ligaments and surrounding muscles to absorb impact and enable smooth motion.

shoulder.name: Shoulder
shoulder.description: The shoulder is the body's most mobile joint — a ball-and-socket design powered by the rotator cuff muscles that balance stability with an incredible range of motion.

brain.name: Brain
brain.description: The brain drives every movement you make. Through neuroplasticity, targeted rehabilitation can rewire neural pathways and restore function after injury or stroke.

muscle.name: Muscles
muscle.description: Skeletal muscles contract to produce movement. Progressive strengthening builds the force and endurance your body needs to recover and stay injury-free.

spineViewer.title: Explore the
spineViewer.description: Click any of the 25 vertebrae — C1 through C7, T1 through T12, L1 through L5, and the sacrum — to learn about its role and clinical significance.

ankleFoot.title: Ankle & Foot
ankleFoot.description: An interactive 3D model of the ankle and foot, rendered locally for fast loading. Use the sidebar or click any structure in the 3D view to explore every bone, nerve, artery and ligament.
ankleFoot.hint: Select a structure from the sidebar to learn more
